K01.title: Strong, medium and weak applicants
K01.actual: 2001 (strong): 100 high, rank 1; 2004 (medium): 63 medium, rank 19; 2005 (weak): 48.5 low, rank 22

K02.title: Not eligible: height 172 cm and nationality Egypt
K02.expected: not eligible with both reasons, kept out of the ranking, score shown in grey
K02.actual: Completed; eligibility not_eligible; failed rules: الجنسية: المصرّح به مصر — المطلوب ضمن: السعودية | الطول (سم): المصرّح به 172 سم — المطلوب 180 سم أو أكثر; ranked: False

K03a.title: Public form: height left blank on an opening with a height rule
K03a.expected: the form asks for the height before sending (the console case K03b shows the engine side)

K04.title: Blank answer vs the answer 0
K04.expected: blank → level 0 + «دليل ناقص» flag (needs review on a mandatory criterion); 0 → level 0 with the evidence «0», no flag
K04.actual: 2021 (no CV) years_sup='': level 0, missing_evidence True, eligibility eligible; 2006 years_sup='0': level 0, evidence '0', missing_evidence False

K05.title: The answer says one thing, the CV another
K05.expected: contradiction flag, the lower level is used, needs review before any decision

K06.title: Duplicate applications (same national ID, another e-mail)
K06.expected: linked to the original, grey, only the original is ranked, nothing deleted
K06.actual: 2016 → applicant.2015@example.com; 2024 → applicant.2003@example.com; in the duplicate group: ['hassan.q.second@example.com', 'khaled.d.second@example.com']

K07.title: Editing an answer after the evaluation
K07.expected: result marked stale (grey), out of the ranking; re-score → new score, ranked again
K07.actual: stale 1 after 0.1s; in stale group True; score 63 → 78 after re-score (8.6s, Completed); ranked again True

K08.title: Override one criterion, without and with a reason

K09.title: Shortlist, hold and reject, each with a reason; no reason → refused
